items: added to verbs, forms verbs with the approximate meaning 'in' or 'into' — во- + -йти́ (“to go”) → войти́ (“to go in, to enter”)

added with -ся to verbs, forms verbs with the approximate meaning of thoroughness or completeness of action — в- + чита́ть (“to read”) + -ся → вчита́ться (“to read carefully, delving into the content to better understand”)
